title: director.alchemy/1
description: data/director/alchemy.json: the fight alchemist's switches (sim/director/alchemy.gd, recipe.gd; docs/director/alchemy-plan.md): whether strikes are given a piece, and which pool of data/combat/recipes.json each roster id draws on. The press log's own numbers are Controls' (data/input/timing.json) and the pieces are Combat's (data/combat/recipes.json). Version field: schema. Policy: closed except keys starting with an underscore. Cross-references (every fighters key is a roster id; every value is a key of the recipes pools; a roster id with no entry and no pool of its lower-case id is a warning) are checked by tools/lib/xref-fight.js (alchemy-*).

enabled.description: true: every strike the director plans is given a piece (args.piece on its beat) from the pool its fighter's style calls; false: strikes carry no piece.

additionalProperties.description: The key of data/combat/recipes.json pools this roster id draws on.

fighters.description: Roster id to the key of data/combat/recipes.json pools (a fighter not listed uses his id in lower case).

enabled.description: false: a string has no flow.

max.description: The most flow a string reaches.

lapseTicks.description: Ticks without a press after which the flow lapses.

enderAfter.description: The flow at which the string's ender is the flow's own.

launchAt.description: The flow at which a launch takes the panel.

showcaseAt.description: The flow at which a showcase ender can replace the plain one.

dmgPer.description: The damage each flow adds to a blow of the string.

contest.description: The flow a won contest pays.

contestMax.description: The most flow contests can pay a string.

flow.description: The flow of a string (agency-pass.md section 2; sim/director/alchemy.gd).

comboMul.description: The damage multiplier of a clean and hard combo tap.

enabled.description: false: a blur string has no pattern or cadence.

cadences.description: The ticks between the blows of a blur string; the string draws one (agency-pass.md section 20).

minLeadTicks.description: The least lead, in ticks, a blur blow has over its press.

timedMul.description: The multiplier of a timed press in a blur string.

fullEnderFlow.description: The flow at which the blur's ender is the full one (a warning if above flow.max).
